Chapter 614: Chapter 38: The Value Of The Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 614: Chapter 38: The Value of the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter (Seeking Subscriptions)

“Origin Fine Gold…” Lin Yuan carefully observed.

After absorbing his True Body and two Primordial Spirits in the World of Gods, this Secret Treasure had undergone several transformations.

The aura it now exuded was not much different from that of a Tenth Rank Secret Treasure.

“By activating the Origin Clock and adding ‘Elemental Body’ and ‘Blood Rebirth’ Divine Skills, my defensive capabilities should be comparable to the Tenth Rank, right?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The more than two billion Spatial Layers allowed Lin Yuan’s full eruption of power to surpass the ordinary Tenth Rank,

...

even transcending most of the Tenth Rank in his understanding of the essence of space.

In terms of defense, with the help of the Origin Clock and two Divine Skills, Lin Yuan was also comparable to any Tenth Rank.

The defense here was direct,

and in fact, occupying more than two billion Spatial Layers, it was very difficult for anyone, as strong as the Tenth Rank, to lock onto his True Body’s position.

Not to mention attacking him.

“Once I finish this expedition in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, I’ll start preparing for my break through to the Tenth Rank…” Lin Yuan made up his mind.

He believed he had reached the pinnacle at the Ninth Rank stage, and as for continuing to open Spatial Layers? There was completely no need.

The twenty plus billion Spatial Layers, even if Lin Yuan spent a lot of time opening tens of thousands more layers, would almost have no impact compared to the twenty plus billion scale.

Moreover, after reaching more than twenty billion layers, the difficulty of opening each additional layer was unimaginably higher than before.

“That Hunyi really had quite a few good items,” Lin Yuan thought, as he killed Hunyi in the Xuanhuang World and casually took the opponent’s Space Bracelet, also glancing at the treasures inside.

There were Secret Treasures, some ‘Xuanhuang Crystals,’ and some opportunities gained from the Secret Realm itself.

All together, they were worth about two million Cubic Universe Crystals.

While this was certainly less compared to the normal special Ninth Rank price, considering that it was Hunyi’s Avatar entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, not bringing too precious treasures was normal.

Although a powerhouse that opened tens of millions of Spatial Layers virtually had no match in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, it did not mean they could not die.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm itself still held many dangers, especially in the core area, where there were places capable of severely injuring special Ninth Rank individuals.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

With a thought, Lin Yuan, along with Xilan, ventured into the depths of the multitudinous Spatial Layers.

“Galaxy Master, I guess I’m done for,” Xilan sighed, her vitality exhausted, unable to contain the continuous burning of her Physical Soul and Spirit Will for two and a half years.

At this moment, Xilan’s life signs had plummeted to the bottom.

“I’ll take your treasures back for you,” Lin Yuan understood Xilan’s condition, and if it had been in the outside world, it might have been possible to save her with many cosmic Rare Treasures.

But not in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

In fact, even if those means were available, Xilan would not have used them, as it was just an Avatar after all. If it fell, she could still convene another one.

To waste so many life-saving cosmic Rare Treasures for this would be completely unnecessary.

“Thank you, Galaxy Master,” Xilan nodded, her form rapidly dissipating.

She could have maintained herself for a few more months, but there was no need to do so. It was inevitable that she would disintegrate, and dissolving earlier would allow her to convene a new Avatar sooner.

“Brother Xilan.”

Lin Yuan collected Xilan’s leftover Space Bracelet, deciding to allocate a small portion of the gains he would make on his way to the core area to her.

Without Xilan, it would have been difficult for Lin Yuan to have made it this far, and he acknowledged this favor.

“A calling sensation?” Lin Yuan looked up towards the core area of the Secret Realm, understanding it deeper with the surge in the number of Spatial Layers he opened.

If Lin Yuan was right, that calling sensation was situated in one of the Spatial Layers of the core area.

“Let’s go and find out.”

After pondering briefly, Lin Yuan quickly headed towards the core area.

This time, Lin Yuan did not conceal his aura, but intentionally displayed it, attracting the attention of the indigenous lifeforms of the Secret Realm.

Under that calling sensation, Lin Yuan had no time to specifically search for native life to kill, but it did not hinder his drawing them in to kill.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, he could virtually sweep through the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and no matter how many native lifeforms came, they were merely delivering Cubic Universe Crystals to him.

Boom, boom, boom.

Under the stirring of the numerous Spatial Layers, even the nearby Ninth Rank Different Species became aware.

“This is bad, that’s the Galaxy Master.”

“Hurry, keep your distance, even Hunyi died at the hands of the Galaxy Master, forced into self-detonation.”

“Go, go, go, don’t let the Galaxy Master spot you.”

“The Galaxy Master is heading towards the core area?”

“This exploration, let’s stay as far from the core area as possible.”

…

Countless Ninth Rank Aliens were terrified, dreading that the Galaxy Master might discover them,

especially those Alien Strong Ones who had strained relationships with Human Civilization, who were particularly fearful and apprehensive.

Even the few special Ninth Rank, upon sensing the aura of the Galaxy Master, quickly fled far away, not daring to stay any longer.

Who were they kidding?

Even Hunyi had perished at the hands of the Galaxy Master, let alone them?

Even if a few special Ninth Rank were slightly stronger than Hunyi, the Galaxy Master didn’t struggle much to kill Hunyi.

To kill them, who were similar special Ninth Rank, it probably wouldn’t be much trouble either.

In such circumstances, those special Ninth Rank naturally kept as far away as possible; even those without significant grievances toward Human Civilization refused to get too close to the Galaxy Master.
